analogy.rationale: NOD1 is a cytosolic innate immune sensor that signals through RIP2/NF-kB and MAPK to induce inflammatory cytokines; however, these cell lines are not immune cells and NOD1 expression/activation is minimal, so NOD1 inhibitors should produce little transcriptional response. NF-kB pathway and IKK inhibitors act on the same downstream axis and would be the closest analogs if any signal were present.
